title: Interacting dark energy constraints from Fermi GRBs and Pantheon+ SNe Ia with full GRB covariance
efc_relevance: Extends the interacting-DE redshift lever arm via Fermi GRBs at z > 3, well beyond the SN-Ia horizon; tightens the dark-sector coupling kernel that EFC's L1→L2 transition must reproduce endogenously. Adds high-z anchor orthogonal to BAO and CMB-lensing arms.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as high-z lever-arm probe; cross-reference framework:CoupledDE-DM-Amendola2000, arXiv:2604.25373 and arXiv:2604.21671; required mapping of GRB-covariance posterior into the EFC L1 effective coupling.
